candidate.scope: Default shallow memoization of native transcript row. No custom comparator, markup, CSS, scroll owner, gesture, queue or localization change. Internal row export permits focused boundary tests.

limits: Private React fiber traversal changes scheduling. This is count evidence only.
Only function, forwardRef and simple-memo fibers with message or render-item identity are counted. Host nodes and memo-wrapper tag 14 are excluded.
A changed fiber pointer plus PerformedWork marks a render. Calibration independently verifies memo bailouts, prop changes, context updates and local state.
Counts cover the observer start/stop window. The 300 ordered updates are verified after the observer stops, so not every update must produce a render inside the window.
Message identity counters aggregate several component layers for each message. They are not counts for one component.
No speed, CPU-duration, INP, M2 Air, battery, or heap-leak claim.

decision.reason: Streaming task-time rate is approximately flat. Normalized script work is mixed. Normalized streaming style and layout durations increase in both pairs. Streaming p95 is flat in one pair and 16.7% worse in the other. Normal idle task work increases in both pairs. Reduced-motion idle savings and fewer streaming long tasks do not override these results.

preservation.decision: Unchanged-prop row renders were removed, but normal streaming task rate was flat and p95 worsened in one pair. Normal idle work and streaming style cost were worse in both pairs. No useful full-view gain. No six-pair confirmation, navigation timing or production acceptance.

decision.nextAction: Investigate mounted subscriptions and recurring history refreshes on restored 9e20 before choosing another production change.
